title.zh: 终端猜Agent状态的时代要结束了，Claude Code、Codex接连跟进OSC7501
title.en: 终端猜Agent状态的时代要结束了，Claude Code、Codex接连跟进OSC7501

current_state.zh: The OSC 7501 terminal status protocol, which lets coding agents report working/waiting/done/error states directly to terminals, has been adopted by Claude Code, Grok Build, open-source agents, and several terminal emulators, with OpenAI's Codex support merged but not yet in a stable release.
current_state.en: The OSC 7501 terminal status protocol, which lets coding agents report working/waiting/done/error states directly to terminals, has been adopted by Claude Code, Grok Build, open-source agents, and several terminal emulators, with OpenAI's Codex support merged but not yet in a stable release.
